solidworks_motion_calculate_and_play.doc: Compute one motion study, then optionally play the animation back. Writes the computed results into the study and does not save; the returned value is Calculate's boolean, which has lied before, so check the outcome with solidworks_motion_collect_summary as well.

params.play: Whether to play the animation after a successful calculation; false only calculates. Defaults to true.
params.motion_study_name: Motion study name; when empty a single study is used, none raises an error and more than one raises asking you to name it. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_motion_export_avi.doc: Export one motion study animation to a file and report whether the file really appeared with a non-zero size. Writes the file, whose parent directory must already exist; duration and frame rate come from the SolidWorks defaults because the parameter object cannot cross this boundary.

params.file_path: Output file path including the extension; .bmp and .tga are also accepted by the same member, and the parent directory must already exist.
params.motion_study_name: Motion study name; an empty value follows the same single-study rule as solidworks_motion_calculate_and_play. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_surface_create_extruded.doc: Create a surface extrude feature from an existing sketch of the active part. Writes a surface feature and does not save; success is judged by the feature tree growing, because the call returns nothing.

params.depth_mm: Extrude depth in millimetres; the conversion to metres happens once at this boundary.
params.sketch_name: Name of the sketch to extrude; empty uses the current sketch. Defaults to empty.
params.through_all: Whether to extrude through all geometry instead of the given depth; this mode is not verified and the feature tree did not change on a real machine. Defaults to false.

solidworks_surface_knit.doc: Join the selected surfaces of the active part into one surface body. Writes a knit feature and does not save; the selected faces need selection mark 1, and success means the feature tree grew and the body count dropped.

params.knit_tolerance_mm: Knit tolerance in millimetres; the valid range is 0.0001 to 0.1. Defaults to 0.0001.
params.try_to_form_solid: Whether to turn the knitted surface into a solid when possible. Defaults to false.

solidworks_surface_extend.doc: Extend a surface of the active part by a distance along or beyond its own shape. Writes an extend feature and does not save; success is judged by the feature tree growing, because the call returns nothing.

params.distance_mm: Extension distance in millimetres; zero is rejected.
params.extend_linear: Whether to extend linearly instead of following the same curved surface. Defaults to true.
params.end_condition: Extension end condition, where 0 uses the given distance and 1 extends to a selected point, which is not verified. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_surface_fill.doc: Create a surface patch over a closed boundary of the active part. Writes a fill surface feature and does not save; boundary edges must be selected with mark 1, and success needs both a returned feature and a bigger feature tree.

params.resolutions: Surface resolution, one of 1, 2 or 3, where a higher value gives a better quality patch. Defaults to 2.
params.options: Bitmask of swFeatureFillSurfaceOptions_e flags. Defaults to 1, which is the optimize-surface flag.
params.selection: Declarative selection of the boundary edge loop to fill; leaving it empty picks the highest loop automatically. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_activate_model_for_preview.doc: Activate the document to review so preview capture does not photograph another active part or sub-assembly. Modifies the active document state and may mark it as modified, because view and selection changes count.

solidworks_clear_selection_for_preview.doc: Clear the current selection so the preview does not show highlighted entities. Modifies the view state and may mark the document as modified, because selection changes count.

solidworks_refresh_scene_graph.doc: Refresh the graphics scene graph so an appearance change becomes visible. Modifies the view state and may mark the document as modified, because view changes count.

params.update: Whether to force a graphics update. Defaults to true.

solidworks_drawing_list_sheets.doc: List the sheets of the active drawing: how many there are, their names and which one is current. Read-only and active-document only, so no path is needed; it raises when the active document is not a drawing.

solidworks_drawing_get_current_sheet.doc: Read the current sheet of the active drawing: paper size, width and height, scale and sheet-format name. Read-only; width and height are reported in millimetres although the underlying call returns metres, and the conversion happens once here.

solidworks_drawing_list_views.doc: List the views on the current sheet with each name and type code. Read-only and active-document only; the sheet itself is filtered out because the raw call returns it as a pseudo-view with type 1.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_unfold.doc: Insert an unfold feature so the sheet-metal part shows its flat pattern. Writes the feature and does not save; a fixed face is picked by index with selection mark 1, and success is judged by the feature tree and the flat-pattern count.

params.bend_feature_names: Comma separated bend feature names to select with mark 4; a real machine builds the unfold even when this is empty, but the argument has no default, so pass an empty string to leave it out.
params.face_index: Zero-based index of the face to keep fixed; face order is not guaranteed stable across rebuilds. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_fold.doc: Insert a fold feature to close a flat pattern back into its bent state. Writes the feature and does not save; the unfold feature is selected with mark 0 after the selection is cleared, and a fixed face is picked by index with mark 1.

params.bend_feature_names: Comma separated bend feature names to select with mark 4; leaving it empty still builds the feature on a real machine. Defaults to empty.
params.face_index: Zero-based index of the face to keep fixed; face order is not guaranteed stable across rebuilds. Defaults to 0.
params.unfold_feature_name: Name of an existing unfold feature to select with mark 0 before folding; empty means none is selected. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_sheet_metal_create_hem.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: every hem shape returns nothing, so no hem is created. It would write a hem feature on one selected edge and does not save the document, and calling it raises an error naming the reason unless the unverified probe path is explicitly allowed.

params.edge_selector: Declarative edge selector: 'index:<n>' for the n-th edge on the body, or '__current_selection__' to reuse the selection; edges cannot be selected by name.
params.hem_type: Hem shape: open (0), closed (1), teardrop (2), rolled (3) or double (4). Defaults to 'open'.
params.position: Hem position, 'inside' or 'outside', where the numeric values 0 and 1 come from the factory type library. Defaults to 'outside'.
params.reverse: Whether to reverse the direction. Defaults to false.
params.length_mm: Hem length in millimetres. Defaults to 0.01.
params.gap_mm: Gap in millimetres, used only by the open hem. Defaults to 0.01.
params.angle_deg: Hem angle in degrees, used only by teardrop and rolled hems. Defaults to 0.
params.radius_mm: Hem radius in millimetres, used only by teardrop and rolled hems. Defaults to 0.005.
params.miter_gap_mm: Mitre gap in millimetres. Defaults to 0.0011.
params.use_default_relief: Whether to use the default relief cut. Defaults to false.
params.relief: Relief shape: rectangular (1), tear (2), obround (3), none (4) or tear_bend (5). Defaults to 'obround'.
params.relief_tear: Tear relief style: rip (1) or extend (2). Defaults to 'rip'.
params.use_relief_ratio: Whether the relief is sized by a ratio. Defaults to true.
params.relief_width_mm: Relief width in millimetres. Defaults to 0.
params.relief_depth_mm: Relief depth in millimetres. Defaults to 0.
params.k_factor: K factor of the custom bend allowance. Defaults to 0.5.

solidworks_drawing_sheets_summary.doc: Return a per-sheet summary of the active drawing, including sheet names and view counts. Read-only; it answers several sheet questions in one call so the caller does not need two round trips.

solidworks_drawing_current_sheet_info.doc: Return information about the sheet currently being edited as a dict. Read-only; use it when only the current sheet matters, and solidworks_drawing_list_sheets when every sheet is wanted.

solidworks_sheet_metal_iter_features.doc: List the sheet-metal features of the active part by walking the feature tree in order. Read-only; use solidworks_weldment_iter_features instead for weldment features, which are a different family.

solidworks_topology_constraints_report.doc: Report the constraints and controls already built in a topology study, one entry per constraint with its parameters. Read-only and JSON-able; it needs a topology study object, and the list variant reports booleans instead.

solidworks_part_wrap.doc: Create a wrap feature from a selected sketch and face, embossing, debossing or scribing the profile onto the surface. Writes the feature and does not save; the sketch must be a 2D sketch with mark 4 and the face needs mark 1, and only the emboss type is confirmed on a real machine.

params.wrap_type: Wrap type: 'emboss' to raise the profile, 'deboss' for the engraved variant or 'scribe' for a score line; only emboss is confirmed on a real machine, and the other values still build an emboss type name. Defaults to 'emboss'.
params.thickness_mm: Wrap thickness in millimetres. Defaults to 1.
params.reverse: Whether to reverse the wrap direction. Defaults to false.
